sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents, highlighting how LangGraph enables more reliable multi-step agent workflows. Shared benchmarks showing 40% improvement in task completion rates for complex developer tooling scenarios.

sources.author: Sarah Guo
sources.headline: Founder @ Conviction
sources.post_summary: Analyzed the current AI infrastructure landscape, noting that inference costs have dropped 60% in the last quarter. Emphasized the shift toward specialized hardware and edge deployment for production AI systems.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI Researcher
sources.post_summary: Shared practical insights on building reliable automation with LLMs, including new patterns for handling tool failures and state management in agent systems. Warned against over-engineering simple automation tasks.

sources.author: Emmanuel Ameisen
sources.headline: Head of AI @ Anthropic
sources.post_summary: Explored the intersection of AI agents and developer productivity, presenting data from internal tools showing 3x faster debugging cycles when using agent-assisted code review systems.

sources.author: Elena Voss
sources.headline: GTM Engineer @ Ramp | Ex-Notion
sources.post_summary: Discussed building a GTM engineering function that owns outbound infrastructure end-to-end. Shared how her team uses custom data pipelines and enrichment layers to reduce time-to-first-meeting by 40%. Emphasized treating outbound like product development with version control and testing.

sources.author: Marcus Hale
sources.headline: Head of Revenue Operations @ Deel
sources.post_summary: Wrote about aligning sales ops, marketing ops, and customer success data into a single revenue model. Highlighted using attribution modeling and cohort analysis to improve pipeline accuracy. Argued that RevOps should own the full funnel metrics, not just CRM hygiene.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Founder @ Outbound OS | GTM Advisor
sources.post_summary: Shared a framework for outbound automation that combines intent signals with multi-channel sequencing. Explained how her clients reduced manual SDR work by 65% while improving reply rates. Stressed the importance of human-in-the-loop review for high-intent leads.

sources.author: Liam Chen
sources.headline: Content Strategy Lead @ Webflow
sources.post_summary: Explored how content strategy should be tied directly to revenue operations through topic clusters mapped to buying stages. Shared data showing that content-supported deals closed 28% faster. Advocated for content teams to report into RevOps rather than marketing.

sources.author: Danny Postma
sources.headline: Founder & CEO @ Typedream | No-code builder
sources.post_summary: Shared how he built and shipped a new AI-powered landing page generator in under 10 days as a solo founder. Broke down the tech stack, user feedback loop, and how he used no-code tools to validate before writing code.

sources.author: Sara Mauskopf
sources.headline: Founder & CEO @ Winnie | Ex-Google, Stripe
sources.post_summary: Wrote about her decision to leave big tech and go all-in on her second startup. Detailed the emotional side of the career pivot, early traction metrics, and how she's approaching product development differently this time.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Indie Maker | Founder @ Nomad List, Remote OK
sources.post_summary: Posted a weekly update on his new AI side project, including revenue numbers, user growth, and the specific features he shipped that week. Emphasized staying small and profitable without raising funding.

sources.author: Vic Vijayakumar
sources.headline: Software Engineer | Building in Public
sources.post_summary: Documented his transition from marketing to software engineering. Shared his 6-month learning roadmap, first freelance projects, and how public accountability helped him stay consistent through the career change.

sources.author: Arvid Kahl
sources.headline: Author, Bootstrapped Founder | Ex-FeedbackPanda
sources.post_summary: Reflected on the realities of solo product development after exiting his previous company. Discussed choosing micro-SaaS ideas, avoiding scope creep, and the mental model he uses for sustainable solo building.
